```yaml
name: Publish Remote Config

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "kiln/remote_config.py"
      - "kiln/models.py"
      - "kiln/cli.py"
      - "tests/test_remote_config.py"

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv sync --all-extras --dev

      - name: Run ruff checks
        run: |
          uvx ruff check --select I
          uvx ruff format --check .

      - name: Run pyright
        run: |
          uv run pyright .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          uv run python3 -m pytest --benchmark-quiet -q .

      - name: Export remote config
        run: |
          uv run python3 -m kiln export-remote-config

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./remote_config.json
          publish_branch: gh-pages
          commit_message: "Publish remote config"
```
